Veterans Benefits: Nebraska excludes military retirement pay from state taxable income. Qualifying veterans may receive income-based homestead relief or disabled-veteran property-tax relief; confirm current eligibility with Nebraska Department of Veterans' Affairs.
Description: North Platte is a Lincoln County regional center on the Platte River with an in-city VA clinic, Union Pacific railroad heritage, and access to Lake Maloney and Buffalo Bill State Recreation Area. It offers a practical, car-oriented small-city base for people who value quiet, outdoor recreation, and regional services; its amenities and job market are more limited than a larger metro.
